study: The realistic twins of PR5's live executor: each twin's record from its engine's first minute to 2026-10-02 21:05 UTC, computed by the production code on PR5's stored record (not a test with a verdict; docs/agents/reviews/2026-10-02-pr5-realistic-twins-prereg.md). Since 2026-10-03 each twin is a row of agent_quote_twin_specs (0088), whose backfill the row pins; p50's, 'Stablecoin quotes variant-1', is the first added that way (docs/agents/reviews/2026-10-03-pr5-size-twin-prereg.md)
run: cd scripts && npx --yes deno@1.46.3 run --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env backfill.ts pr5  # -> ../pr5.json.gz (the bytes its spec row pins)
cd scripts && npx --yes deno@1.46.3 run --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env backfill.ts d  # -> ../d.json.gz; prints no figure of its results (rule D's no-peek)

cd scripts && npx --yes deno@1.46.3 run --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env backfill.ts p50  # -> ../p50.json.gz, 'Stablecoin quotes variant-1' (PR5's rule at £600): the size study's s50 run, figure for figure
backfill.ts <id> builds any twin of the spec rows the migrations insert (spec_rows.ts reads them), a later variant's too

sources.inputs/twins_inputs.json.gz: production, SELECT only, 2026-10-02 21:08:45 UTC, every row before 21:08:00: agent_quote_prints (id|book|ms|price|qty|side), agent_quote_inputs (kind|ms|value), agent_quote_minutes (book|ms|x|x_t|fair_u|hours_n|prints_n, and book|ms|recorded_at), agent_quote_events (book, ms, side, k, kind, ticks, detail; tab-separated), agent_quoted_events of arm d, kinds order/refused/withdraw only (book|ms|side|k|kind|what|ticks|oid|leg|why), and the minutes of edge_call_beats for agents?action=quotes; each read with its md5, which matched
sources.pr5.json.gz, d.json.gz, p50.json.gz: scripts/backfill.ts on the inputs: each twin's tables as the code left them (orders without their ids), loaded by the agents function's quotestwins call; pr5.json.gz and p50.json.gz built again on the code of 2026-10-03 (the twins as rows, 0088) to the same bytes
